afterFileEdit.command: [ -d .git ] && git add wiki/ .raw/ .vault-meta/ 2>/dev/null && (git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "wiki: auto-commit $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" 2>/dev/null) || true

stop.command: [ -d wiki ] && [ -d .git ] && git diff --name-only HEAD 2>/dev/null | grep -q '^wiki/' && echo 'WIKI_CHANGED: update wiki/hot.md with a brief summary (<500 words, factual, overwrite). Format: Last Updated, Key Recent Facts, Recent Changes, Active Threads.' || true
